messages.subject: Temporal effect, AR1 or RW2
parts:
Hi all,

I am developing a spatiotemporal model. For the temporal part, Should I use AR1 or RW2? Is there any selection criteria?

Thanks,
Ruby

messages.author: 9940b4fcc153c7d7
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Temporal effect, AR1 or RW2
parts:
Hi Ruby,

My best answer to this question is that "no-one knows". I believe the AR1 is a slightly more common choice.

There may be specific cases where one of the models make little sense, or do not converge well. 

In general I suggest looking at the residuals and at predictive criterion. Sometimes you find extreme differences in DIC/WAIC/CPO, which also gives a hint.

Kind regards,
Haakon Bakka
